rejected_assets.reason: The blue synthetic hacking interface looked like a low-cost science-fiction overlay and did not provide a credible physical analogue for agentic cyber operations.
The stadium corridor crowd did not represent ordinary shared urban life and would misstate the narration's distributed social consequences.
The green hacker-screen imagery was a visual cliché and could be mistaken for proof of an attack rather than defensive cyber operations context.
The previous shot prominently combined Swiss and EU flags and was misleading in a section specifically about EU AI Act designation rules.
The previous computer screen visibly showed a sales-customer interface and was unrelated to independent technical evaluation or audit.
The classroom-style technology-business presentation lacked the authority and visual quality required for incident reporting and formal oversight.
